value.notes: First exploratory run. Goal: map layout, basic movement, pause/resume, dash, use. Next: examine tiles/HUD in result, then probe timer, pause-tick input, dialogs, restart, spikes, enemies, exit.

Suspected score underflow: spikes subtract 500 from score, but score went 100 -> 65136 (= 100-500 mod 65536) in run 1 at spikes tile (5,8). Verifying with shortest path to spikes at (3,3) from start with score 0. Expected score 0 after spikes; if observed 65036 it's confirmed. Afterwards: check other score paths, enemies collision, dash-over-enemy, restart, timer expiry, exit, Game over/Retry, invulnerability, dash through locked door, gates, levers, heart at 5 lives.

Confirmed score underflow: spikes at (3,3) subtract 500 from score 100 and show 65136 (100-500 mod 65536). Run 2 (down down right right) reproduced it. Now testing shorter dash variant: dash-down (1,1)->(1,3) collects coin, dash-right (1,3)->(3,3) hits spikes. Expect score 0 after spikes, observed likely 65136. Still to probe: enemy collision, restart, timer, exit, gates, levers, heart at 5 lives, dash through locked door.

reports.title: Spikes drive score negative and it wraps to 65136
reports.observed: After collecting a coin (score 100) and stepping onto spikes at (3,3), score shows 65136 (100-500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit). HUD shows Score 65136.
reports.expected: Score never goes below 0; spikes subtract 500 but the score stops at 0, so it should read 0.

value.notes: Confirmed score underflow (spikes at (3,3) with score 100 -> 65136). Run 3 (dash-down dash-right) was not a bug: second dash was ordinary step because dash cooldown was 5. Now probing pause input: 'pause+right' should not move the player; 'enter' should resume and 'right' should move. Still to probe: enemy collision and swap, timer 0 respawn, exit/finish flow, gates/levers, heart at 5 lives, restart, dash through locked door, click buttons visibility, HUD vs state.

value.notes: Confirmed one bug so far: spikes at (3,3) push the score below zero and it wraps to 65136 (65536-400) instead of clamping at 0. Reproduced on seed 42 with down, down, right, right. Score goes 0 -> 100 (coin at (1,3)) -> spikes -500 -> 65136. Pause/resume input was checked and behaved as specified in run 4. Not yet probed: enemy collision and swap, timer-0 respawn, exit/finish flow, gates and levers, heart at 5 lives, restart, dash through locked doors, button visibility, and HUD versus state. Stopping here because the tick budget is limited and the one confirmed bug is solid.
